notes.end_pct: change in account value from start to the last close, after trading costs
notes.worst_fall_pct: largest fall from a previous high, as a positive number (6.2 = fell 6.2%)
notes.total_cost_pct: all trading costs paid, as a % of the starting account
notes.trade_count: one trade = one stock changed on one day (changes under 0.5% skipped)
notes.spy: bought at the first open, paying the same 5 bps once, then held
notes.equal_weight_hold: $1 split equally over the same 10 stocks at the first open, 5 bps once, never traded again
